items.name: tokens
items.title: Design tokens
items.description: The design tokens Facade UI needs: shadcn colour names, plus --facade-* variables for heading sizes, section spacing and animation. The default colours are Tailwind's orange and stone. Import the file in your globals.css.

items.name: themes
items.title: Theme presets
items.description: Three more colour themes: neutral, warm and vivid. Apply one with the data-facade-theme attribute. The default orange theme is in the tokens file.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn
items.description: A helper that merges class names, using clsx and tailwind-merge. It is the same as the one in shadcn/ui, so installing it changes nothing if you already have it.

items.name: types
items.title: Shared types
items.description: Types that every section uses: heading levels, image and link components you can replace, and call-to-action items.

items.name: motion-primitives
items.title: Motion primitives
items.description: Animation building blocks: FacadeMotionProvider, FadeIn, Reveal, Stagger and Collapse. They animate only opacity and transform, and follow the reduced-motion setting.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button built on Base UI, with Facade styles. Every size is at least 44 by 44 pixels.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label for a status or category. You can add a prefix that only screen readers announce.

items.name: heading
items.title: Heading
items.description: Renders an h1 to h6 from a number, so you set the heading level and the visual size separately.

items.name: eyebrow
items.title: Eyebrow
items.description: The small label above a section heading. It is a paragraph, not a heading.

items.name: container
items.title: Container
items.description: Sets the maximum width and side padding that every section uses. Both come from the container tokens.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: The outer wrapper of a section. It sets the element, the vertical spacing, and the link to the heading that names the section.

items.name: section-header
items.title: Section header
items.description: An eyebrow, a heading and a description. It also sets the heading id that a section uses for its accessible name.

items.name: cta-group
items.title: CTA group
items.description: A row of call-to-action links styled as buttons. Because they are links, people can open them in a new tab.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: One number with its label, as part of a description list. You can give a spoken form for abbreviated values.

items.name: logo-mark
items.title: Logo mark
items.description: One customer logo, with an optional link. Logos get the same visual height, and the company name is available to screen readers.

items.name: feature-icon
items.title: Feature icon
items.description: A tinted box that holds an icon. You pass an icon component, and it is hidden from screen readers.

items.name: testimonial
items.title: Testimonial
items.description: A quote with the name of the person who said it, and an optional star rating that screen readers announce as text.

items.name: pricing-tier
items.title: Pricing tier
items.description: One pricing plan as a card. The price has a spoken form, a feature that is not included says so in words, and you can mark a plan as recommended.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field built on Base UI's Field, which connects the label, help text and error message to the input. The border has a contrast of at least 3:1.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A drop-down list built on Base UI's Select and Field. The label, help text and error message are connected to the control, and a hidden input carries the chosen value when a form is submitted.

items.name: nav-top
items.title: Top navigation
items.description: A site header and navigation bar built from one list of links. Large screens get dropdown menus. Small screens get a drawer that keeps keyboard focus inside it.

items.name: hero-centered
items.title: Hero — centred
items.description: A centred landing page hero: eyebrow, headline, text and buttons, with optional media below.

items.name: hero-centered-motion
items.title: Hero — centred (motion)
items.description: The centred hero, with its parts appearing one after another when the page loads.

items.name: hero-split
items.title: Hero — split
items.description: A landing page hero with text on one side and media on the other. The text comes first in reading order on every screen size.

items.name: hero-split-motion
items.title: Hero — split (motion)
items.description: The split hero, with its parts appearing one after another when the page loads.

items.name: hero-with-media
items.title: Hero — with media
items.description: A landing page hero with centred text over a full-width background image, or above a framed screenshot. Over a background, a dark layer keeps the text readable.

items.name: hero-with-media-motion
items.title: Hero — with media (motion)
items.description: The media hero, with its parts appearing one after another when the page loads.

items.name: logo-cloud
items.title: Logo cloud
items.description: A "trusted by" row of customer logos. Company names are available as text, so screen readers announce a list of names, not unlabelled images.

items.name: logo-cloud-motion
items.title: Logo cloud (motion)
items.description: The logo cloud, with logos fading in one after another.

items.name: usp-list
items.title: USP list
items.description: Three or four short selling points or benefits, each with an icon and a line of text.

items.name: usp-list-motion
items.title: USP list (motion)
items.description: The USP list, with items appearing one after another.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature grid
items.description: A features section: a grid of feature cards, two to four per row. A whole card can be a link while its accessible name stays short.

items.name: feature-grid-motion
items.title: Feature grid (motion)
items.description: The feature grid, with cards appearing one after another.

items.name: feature-rows
items.title: Feature rows
items.description: Rows of media and text that alternate sides. Only the layout alternates: in reading order, the text always comes first.

items.name: feature-rows-motion
items.title: Feature rows (motion)
items.description: The feature rows, each appearing as you scroll to it.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento grid
items.description: Feature tiles in mixed sizes. Tiles are placed in the order you give, so reading order matches what you see.

items.name: bento-grid-motion
items.title: Bento grid (motion)
items.description: The bento grid, with tiles appearing one after another.

items.name: faq-accordion
items.title: FAQ accordion
items.description: A FAQ section: questions and answers built on Base UI's Accordion. Each question is a button inside a heading, browser search finds text in closed answers, and you can add FAQPage structured data.

items.name: faq-accordion-motion
items.title: FAQ accordion (motion)
items.description: The FAQ accordion, with rows appearing as you scroll to them. The open and close animation works without JavaScript.

items.name: cta-band
items.title: CTA band
items.description: A closing call to action band. Choose a muted, card, plain or primary-coloured background.

items.name: cta-band-motion
items.title: CTA band (motion)
items.description: The CTA band, appearing as you scroll to it.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: A site footer with link groups in columns, a brand area, social links and a legal line. Each link group is a separately named navigation landmark.

items.name: stats
items.title: Stats
items.description: A row of key numbers or metrics as a description list. You can give a spoken form for abbreviated values.

items.name: stats-motion
items.title: Stats (motion)
items.description: The stats, with numbers appearing one after another as you scroll to them.

items.name: testimonials-grid
items.title: Testimonials grid
items.description: A social proof section: a grid of customer quotes and reviews. It can use columns of uneven height and still be read in the order you give.

items.name: testimonials-grid-motion
items.title: Testimonials grid (motion)
items.description: The testimonials grid, with quotes appearing one after another as you scroll to it.

items.name: testimonial-single
items.title: Testimonial — single
items.description: One large customer quote, with an optional portrait beside it or a tinted background.

items.name: pricing-tiers
items.title: Pricing tiers
items.description: A pricing table: plans as a row of cards. Each price has a spoken form, and a feature that is not included says so in words.

items.name: pricing-tiers-motion
items.title: Pricing tiers (motion)
items.description: The pricing tiers, with plans appearing one after another as you scroll to them.

items.name: pricing-comparison
items.title: Pricing comparison
items.description: A pricing comparison table with row and column headers. Each cell states its value in text, not only with a tick.

items.name: card-list
items.title: Card list
items.description: A grid of linked cards for blog posts, changelog entries or case studies. Dates are marked up so that software can read them.

items.name: card-list-motion
items.title: Card list (motion)
items.description: The card list, with cards appearing one after another as you scroll to it.

items.name: feature-tabs
items.title: Feature tabs
items.description: Features shown in tabs, built on Base UI. A tab opens when you press Enter, not when you move to it with the arrow keys.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: A "how it works" sequence as an ordered list, so the order is in the markup and not only in the visible numbers.

items.name: steps-motion
items.title: Steps (motion)
items.description: The steps, appearing in order. Here the order of the animation matches the meaning.

items.name: team
items.title: Team
items.description: An "about us" team section. Each social link names the person as well as the network.

items.name: team-motion
items.title: Team (motion)
items.description: The team grid, with people appearing one after another as you scroll to it.

items.name: newsletter
items.title: Newsletter
items.description: An email sign-up (newsletter subscribe) form. It announces the result to screen readers through a live region that is on the page from the start.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: An announcement bar at the top of the page that people can dismiss. It is a named landmark, and it is announced to screen readers only if you turn that on.

items.name: nav-side
items.title: Side navigation
items.description: Side navigation for documentation, with collapsible groups and one named landmark. On small screens it becomes a drawer.

items.name: saas-landing
items.title: SaaS landing page
items.description: A complete SaaS landing page built from Facade UI sections. You supply one content object.

items.name: agency
items.title: Agency site
items.description: An agency or studio website: a hero over an image, a grid of work, process steps, a featured quote and the team.

items.name: product-launch
items.title: Product launch
items.description: A product launch landing page: an announcement banner, a bento grid of highlights, details in tabs and an email sign-up.

items.title: Example content
items.description: Sample content and placeholders shared by the Facade UI examples. Installed with any *-demo item.
